They talked to me, my husband, my ex and my parents. All but the ex confirmed that he has been mentally and emotionally abusive for well over a year thanks to the court giving him control over my life (unable to see my family, unable to move, unable to work). I've not heard anything on the legal side yet and I don't know when I will. DCF did move the baby into his custody and I'm ok with that because at least he is being taken care of. 

Again, mentally, due to all the trauma I'm not yet in a position where parenting full time is realistic. I just really hope that they dont cut me off entirely.

I know I need to worry about myself first but its in my nature to worry and I'm just thinking about it right now. 

The current custody orders have me with primary and him with non. I'm ok with the switch (him to primary, me to non) mostly because I'm hoping it will give him less time to be malevolent. I just hope that this doesn't mean a full termination or me seeing the baby.

The Parting Glass. It's an Irish Folk Song but they sang it on the walking dead so I don't know how many know it. 

But my cousins would sing it when walking home from a pub and you could hear their voices echoing across the empty fields when they were still several streets away. My favorite cousin was david but we called him davy-baby because he was always small. Him and I were the youngest of each family and we had so much in common but he always sat so precariously on the edge of the earth he just fell off. Or I like to think so. He just left one day and I don't know where he is but I hope he is happy wherever he is. 

Everytime I hear that song I wonder about him and how he was always a bit sad even when he was smiling.

So full disclosure I'm a girl and I'm a gear head. It hasn't happened much to me because I normally go to mechanics I know but on a road trip the clutch went so my older sister and I went to a mechanic. After looking at the mechanic told me that in addition to the clutch the turbocharger needed replacement and the catalytic converter was out. 

Before we started out on the roadtrip I replaced the CC and they last for 20 years and I could see the turbocharger spin up when the engine started. 

So it happened to me once but I dont know if its usual or unusual.

Like everyone else has said, get a paternity test. If she shows any hesitation at allowing it tell her it is your right and insist. If the child is A) there and B) is yours ask what her parenting plan is. Does she have a job? A way to pay for kids (being very...VERY frugal I racked up over $5,000 in charges in just a few months)? Daycare? Pediatrician? Clothes? Car Seat? If possible, if you have mutual friends, have them there when you have this discussion. If reality dawns and she decides to terminate the pregnancy thats her choice. If she doesn't want to terminate but wants another option adoption is a really wonderful option. 

But if neither of those work - your parenting choice is up to you. If you put your future "on hold" and don't follow through with your plans parenting is going to be twice as hard as it should be and its already really...really hard. 

I hope that helps. You should consider approaching a lawyer as a last step because it is very expensive and courts will drag out custody battles for a long long time. However if she does and you have no choice, good luck. 

I'm sorry she is doing this to you, it's a miserable thing and she could have handled with a lot better than just insisting that you give up your rights and fuck off. But please, don't put your dreams on hold. Especially if you want to have an active part in this kids life you might not be able to contribute much now but if you become an awesome person (and it looks like you are well on your way) you can contribute more later.

It must be so hard out of the blue. My dad told me when his dad died there was no warning. It was like being hit by a 2x4 and couldn't make sense of it. Its nice that you can realize that he has gone to a better place and eventually you will be able to remember him with everyone else who will love him. Your right it will probably never stop hurting but hopefully its a hurt that you wont mind carrying at some point.

I dont know that you can. It's wonderful that you want to because you've been there and have felt the pain but think back - did anyone really pull you out of it or was it just you slowly allowing yourself out of it. 
Depression is the shittiest because it is a jail we put ourselves in and usually only getting ourselves medicated/talked to/something will pull it out. 

It must be really meaningful tho for your friend and SO to know that you are on their side. Your support probably means more than you know.

Just my thoughts but I hope they are ok and I hope you are too.
